install_attempt_2.script:
set -eu
export CARGO_HOME=<toolchain>/cargo
export RUSTUP_HOME=<toolchain>/rustup
if [ -f /etc/codex/network-policy.json ]; then cat /etc/codex/network-policy.json; else printf '%s\n' 'No managed-cloud network policy file on assigned dev-box VM'; fi
if [ -x "$CARGO_HOME/bin/rustup" ]; then
  "$CARGO_HOME/bin/rustup" --version
  "$CARGO_HOME/bin/rustup" toolchain install 1.99.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
else
  install -d -m 700 <installer>
  cd <installer>
  curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 2 --max-time 60 https://static.rust-lang.org/rustup/dist/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/rustup-init -o rustup-init
  curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 2 --max-time 60 https://static.rust-lang.org/rustup/dist/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/rustup-init.sha256 -o rustup-init.sha256
  sha256sum -c rustup-init.sha256
  chmod 700 rustup-init
  ./rustup-init -y --no-modify-path --default-toolchain 1.99.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
fi
export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
cd <repo>
rustup --version
rustup show active-toolchain
rustup component list --installed
rustc --version --verbose
cargo --version
rustfmt --version
cargo clippy --version
